owner_calls.question: Ms. Marvel episode 3 ('Destined'): Nakia wins her campaign and becomes a board member of her mosque (she tells Kamala she was appointed, and she uses the post to turn away Damage Control). Should a board seat count as a group stage, and under what name? The fan wiki calls the mosque 'Islamic Masjid of Jersey City', and I could not confirm the screen says that name.
options: Add ["Islamic Masjid of Jersey City", "Ms. Marvel"]
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: 'Thanks to her successful campaign, Bahadir became a board member for the Islamic Masjid of Jersey City' (MM103). Wikipedia: Nakia 'runs for a position on the mosque board.'

owner_calls.question: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6: Deke is CEO of his own tech company in Silicon Valley (he says 'This is my company. It's 48,000 square feet'). In the S6 finale ('The Sign') Mack calls him 'Agent Shaw'. Should the company be a stage before S.H.I.E.L.D. in S6? The screen doesn't seem to name it: the fan wiki uses the label 'Deke Shaw's Company'.
options: [["Deke's company", "Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6"], ["S.H.I.E.L.D.", "Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6"]] under a name the owner picks
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki Deke Shaw: title 'CEO of Deke Shaw's Company (formerly)'. Sections 'Becoming a CEO' and 'Shaw's Technological Empire' (S6). In S5 he says he 'wasn't an agent', so the existing S6 S.H.I.E.L.D. stage is right.
